company.description: We are building the real-time interface for human health. Our platform enables predictive and deeply personalized care by continuously and non-invasively decoding molecular signals from your body. As AI reshapes the world, this biological insight in real-time is the foundation for fully autonomous AI physicians across clinical and consumer applications.
